name: Commercial Equipment Service Inc.
old_description: When you own or operate a restaurant or other commercial facility that relies on complex equipment for refrigeration, cooking and other key aspects of your business, you count on that equipment to operate reliably. When you have a problem with your equipment, you need a commercial refrigeration contractor in Wilmington, Edgemoor, or Elsmere, DE who can provide fast, effective and dependable repairs. This is where our commercial and industrial HVAC company enters the picture. Since 1984, our team has provided commercial appliance repair services as well as restaurant equipment sales in Delaware, and we pride ourselves on the quality of our workmanship and customer service. For HVACR, cooking and refrigeration systems in Delaware, there’s no better name in the industry.
about:
Commercial Equipment Service Inc. has operated from Wilmington, Delaware since its founding in 1984. The company provides commercial refrigeration, HVAC, and restaurant equipment services across the region, including the nearby communities of Edgemoor and Elsmere.

The business focuses on repair, installation, and sales of commercial appliances. Its technicians handle refrigeration systems, cooking equipment, and HVAC units for commercial kitchens and facilities. A 24/7 emergency response team is available for urgent breakdowns, and the company also sells new and replacement restaurant equipment.

Primary customers are restaurants and other commercial facilities that rely on refrigeration, cooking, and climate-control systems. The company serves independent eateries, institutional kitchens, and property managers throughout New Castle County.

The firm emphasizes quality workmanship and customer service as its defining traits, positioning itself as a long-standing local specialist for HVACR and cooking equipment in Delaware.
